commit.description: Default: auto, Ork commits a node's work on its branch. never: Ork runs no git commit; worktrees are detached and work stays uncommitted.

merge.description: How a passing child's work reaches its owner. auto: a --no-ff merge (needs commits). patch: its changes are applied, uncommitted. never: left in its own worktree. Default: auto, or patch under commit: never.

base.description: The commit worktrees without an owner start from, e.g. origin/main. Default: HEAD. Ork never fetches.

branch.description: Branch name template over {run}, {node}, {clone} and {inputs.<name>}. Default: ork/{run}/{node}.

worktrees.description: Worktree folder template, relative to the clone, beside it. Default: ../{clone}-worktrees/ork-{run}-{node}.

permissions.description: Tool rules every Claude node gets on top of its own, e.g. deny: ['Bash(git push *)'].

only.description: The only built-in tools the session has; Ork's tools stay.

links.description: Default: on, the user can link a running node to a node of another run. off: its nodes get no message tools unless they have someone to write to, and cannot be linked.

defaults.description: Defaults for every workflow in the project; a workflow's own win.

effort.description: Reasoning effort. Default: Claude Code's for the model.

timeout.description: For tool and Claude nodes that set none; a gate's own timeout is separate.

caveman.description: Terse voice in chat, reports and messages. Default: on.

mcp.description: MCP servers from the project's `.mcp.json` this node's sessions load, beside Ork's own. Default: none.

before.description: A program to run in the node's checkout before its session starts: if it fails, the node fails and no model turn is spent. Its prompt can read {{before.stdout}}, {{before.json.*}}.

command.description: Program and arguments (no shell), or script: instead. Supports templates.

script.description: The text of a short program, instead of command. It takes no templates: values arrive through env:, as $NAME, so a value cannot become code.

interpreter.description: What runs `script:`: a program and arguments. Default: `sh -eu`.

env.description: Environment variables for the program. Values are templates, and may read the user's own variables as {{env.NAME}}.

plainEnv.description: Variables read as {{env.NAME}} that are not secret, such as a region: their values are not masked in what programs print.

format.description: The program's result is JSON, read as output.json: the file at $ORK_OUTPUT if it wrote one, otherwise its stdout.

schema.description: The fields of that JSON a later node relies on, e.g. { state: [OPEN, CLOSED] }. A value outside these fails the node.

list.description: The fields each item has, e.g. { title: string }; { } for no shape.

anyOf.description: A list of items, such as a plan's tasks.

timeout.description: How long the program may run, e.g. 5m; then it is killed and the step fails.

quotas.description: Most this project may spend on this machine. The user's own caps apply too.

dayUsd.description: Most to spend in a calendar day.

dayTokens.description: Most tokens (input, output, cache-write) to use in a calendar day.

weekUsd.description: Most to spend in a calendar week, from Monday.

monthUsd.description: Most to spend in a calendar month.

calls.description: Default: any registered project may call this one's workflows.

accept.description: The registered projects whose workflows may call this one's.

context.description: Context files every node reads, relative to the project root; they come before the workflow's.

experimental.description: Experimental features this project turns on.

heavy.description: The project's full-suite commands, as Bash permission patterns without Bash(…), e.g. pnpm check. A node with verify: may not run them in its session; vitest run does not cover vitest run <files>.

priority.description: Default: low, sessions and tool commands start at a lower OS priority. normal: as the ork process.

followUps.description: Where follow-ups (work a change leaves for later) are kept. Default: Ork's local store.

store.description: store: Ork's local store, never committed (the default). file: appended to a markdown file in the run's worktree, committed with the change. github: an issue through your own gh, falling back to store when gh isn't signed in.

file.description: For store: file, the markdown file, relative to the project root. Default: .ork/follow-ups.md.

label.description: For store: github, the issues' label. Default: ork-follow-up.
